column1: # VOCABULARY AUTHORITIES — hand-maintained. The ONLY hand-entered half of the registry.
# shared/vocabularies/REGISTRY.tsv is GENERATED from the codebase and joined against this
# file. Everything derivable — name, file, declaration form, value count, value hash, derived
# type, consumer count — is derived. This file answers the one question no scan can:
#     WHO says these are the legal values?
# WHY IT IS SEPARATE. If provenance lived in the generated file, regenerating would destroy it.
# Same split as knowledge-base/routines/SEATS.tsv and the tables generated from it.
# authority values:
#   ULAD          checked automatically against docs/fannie-mae/schemas/ulad-enumerations.tsv
#   selling-guide cite a section id that resolves in selling-guide/section-index.tsv
#   reg-z         cite a section + line in docs/reg-z/12-cfr-1026-regulation-z.xml
#   uldd-spec     a ULDD Phase 5 data point with no row in the ULAD mapping sheet
#   internal      a product decision — legitimate, and the default. No citation required.
# A vocabulary absent from this file is treated as `internal`. Adding a row is how a set stops
# being "someone's decision" and starts being checkable.
# vocabularyName
# ULAD / MISMO v3.4 — the enumeration authority is the ULAD mapping workbook, extracted to
# docs/fannie-mae/schemas/ulad-enumerations.tsv. guard:vocab compares these value sets against
# it directly. CLAUDE.md: "Never invent MISMO field names, enumerations, XML container paths,
# edit codes, or Special Feature Codes."
# ⛔ TEN OF THESE CURRENTLY DIVERGE and are baselined, not fixed. Changing a delivered
# enumeration changes what ships in a MISMO file to Fannie Mae; that is a compliance decision,
# not a cleanup, and it is deliberately out of scope here.
AssetType
column4: code carries 8 values ULAD does not, and lacks 5 it does — incl. GiftOfEquity vs ULAD GiftOfPropertyEquity, CashValueOfLifeInsurance vs LifeInsurance, and no way to say Grant

column1: CitizenshipResidencyType
column4: code adds NonResidentAlien + Unknown; ULAD has exactly USCitizen / PermanentResidentAlien / NonPermanentResidentAlien

column1: LiabilityType
column4: code says LeasePayments, ULAD says LeasePayment (singular); code cannot express Open30DayChargeAccount

column1: LienPriorityType
LoanIdentifierType
column4: code says UniversalLoanIdentifier, ULAD says UniversalLoan — and ULI is a required delivery field

column1: LoanPurposeType
MaritalStatusType
column4: ULAD permits Other; the code cannot represent a borrower who is neither married nor unmarried

column1: MortgageType
column4: code says USDA, ULAD says USDARuralDevelopment — shipped at DEAL/LOANS/LOAN/TERMS_OF_MORTGAGE/MortgageType, required: true

column1: PartyRoleType
column4: code adds 7 roles outside the URLA subset (Appraiser, Servicer, …) which may be legitimate MISMO; it also lacks 4 ULAD roles

column1: PropertyUsageType
PriorPropertyTitleType
PriorPropertyUsageType
RefinanceCashOutDeterminationType

# the URLA→MISMO subset only, so absence there is not evidence of invention. These need the
# Phase 5 spec PDF to verify and are recorded as unchecked rather than asserted correct.
BorrowerClassificationType

column1: LoanAmortizationType
